content:
q28.

s3presign runner (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`) — started in `server/server.go:162-171`; driven by a `time.Ticker` fixed 12-hour interval (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `runner.go:27`), plus one immediate `RunOnce` at startup (`server.go:163`). It re-presigns S3 attachment URLs before they expire.

Unused-infra note: The `memopayload` runner (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) is present but the server never starts it — neither `memopayload.NewRunner` nor `Runner.RunOnce` has any caller (`NewRunner`/`RunOnce` reference searches resolve only to the s3presign runner and the definitions themselves). It has no scheduling wiring at all (no ticker, no `Run` loop). Only its standalone helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used, called inline on memo create/update in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`, not on any schedule.
